obligations.summary: Independent factory instances publish one stable/current non-empty finite-profile descriptor; every profile has non-empty operational axes and every progressive profile is constructible through ProgressiveImageDecoding.
All 6144 finite capability requests agree with an independent same-profile oracle and exact fixed-axis failure precedence, preventing false Cartesian products across profiles.
Every format advertised by any decode profile is probed deterministically against a versioned fixed-byte fixture and agrees with descriptor support.
Every format advertising the default complete-primary-CGImage profile decodes its versioned reference still image into bounded deterministic output geometry.
Backend resource estimates are deterministic and positive while conservative host composition preserves both lower bounds.
Encoded-byte, format, dimension and pixel hard limits fail closed with stable ImageCraft errors.
When PreparedImageDecoding is exposed, preparations bind the direct probe, stay decoder-instance scoped, consume exactly once, and discard is idempotent and terminal.

When prepared-resource inspection is exposed, creation authority is deterministic and non-consuming, live-token retained authority matches the predicted resulting state, and authority disappears after discard.
Every format in a profile advertising progressive delivery constructs a session whose cancellation is idempotent and cannot emit later pixel generations.
